definitions.meaning: To deprive of property (feoh), to confiscate

quotations.old_english: Þ-bar; hé wǽre benǽmed, befeód (-fiód, Hpt. Gl. 480, 53)

source_text: be-feón; pp. -feód To deprive of property (feoh), to confiscate:--Þ-bar; hé wǽre benǽmed, befeód (-fiód, Hpt. Gl. 480, 53) infiscaretur, i. fraudaretur, An. Ox. 3157.
